title: Cowboy
description:
This is a third person role-playing game，Players have swords, bows and arrows, and guns（You need to be on a horse to use it）,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Players must maintain health，Players can kill nearby monsters or dodge attacks from monsters.

Control keys:

Right-click targeting

WASD movement

Left mouse button attack

Mouse control direction

R Loaded Weapons

Number keys 1,2,3 switch horse speed

Numeric keys 4,5,6 switch weapons（It only works when you're on a horse）
